home_prompt: Create original website design proposal for 民宿 風帆（ふうはん）, 三重県尾鷲市. Exact1536x86416:9 landscape. Desktop webpage left and narrow mobile website right. Elegant soft sea blue, warm white, sandy beige, simple Japanese typography. Brand text「民宿 風帆」. Original atmospheric illustration of quiet Japanese fishing coast, not actual hotel or room photograph. Headline「尾鷲で、ほっとひと休み。」 Cards「宿泊プラン」「お食事」「アクセス」. MAIN IMPROVEMENT contact and booking instructions wrap entirely within screen, no horizontal clipping, especially mobile. Prominent「ご予約・お問い合わせ」with phone「0597-22-2663」 email「huuhan@cello.ocn.ne.jp」 on separate lines. Note「ご予約は宿泊日の2ヶ月前から」「お急ぎの方はお電話ください」. Button「予約方法を見る」. Avoid prices, invented rooms, ocean view guarantees, onsite hot springs, instant availability, booking form. This business is small seaside inn and not resort. Visible「非公式デザイン案」「写真・イラストはイメージです」. Crisp polished website.
inquiry_prompt: Create separate booking/contact guidance webpage for 民宿 風帆（ふうはん） using reference for sea-blue/ivory visual identity. Exact1536x86416:9 landscape.
